paragraphs: AI: "They raced to build AI. Now they say it’s going too fast." (The Washington Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Dire warnings about AI shock Congress, but action is unlikely before the election" (NBC News).

Political: "Second federal judge freezes Trump mail ballot order with US Supreme Court poised to weigh in" (New York Post) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Trying to Rid the Pentagon of Culture Wars, Hegseth Has Created His Own" (The New York Times).

Economic: "A Republican Senator Walks a Tricky Line on Tariffs as He Seeks Re-Election" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Alaska Sen. Dan Sullivan Walks a Tricky Line on Tariffs as He Seeks Re-Election" (The New York Times).
Financial: "Oil Prices Jump on Energy Supply Worries" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Is A.I. Raising the Chances of Biological Warfare?" (The New York Times).

Geopolitical: "More Than 120 Are Unaccounted For After Ferry Sinks in Indonesia" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Why Scandals Don’t Bring Down Politicians Anymore" (The New York Times).
